name: Boon of the Unending Volley
description: Volley never ends. You can act after placing it, and recasting Volley moves it to the new target area.

name: Boon of the War Banner
description: Battle Shout plants a permanent banner. Enemies within 30 yards deal 10% more damage and take 10% less damage. Recasting Battle Shout moves the banner.
tooltip: Battle Shout plants a movable permanent danger zone.

name: Boon of the Aspect Savant
description: All of your Aspects can be active at once. Aspect of the Cheetah and Aspect of the Pack no longer daze their targets.
tooltip: All Aspects coexist; Cheetah and Pack cannot daze.

name: Boon of the Mirror Image
description: Once every 5 seconds, canceling a cast summons a copy of you that finishes the cast.
tooltip: Canceled casts are finished by a Mirror Image, once every 5 sec.

name: Boon of the Mana Conduit
description: Each tick of Evocation restores 5% of every ally's maximum primary resource within 40 yards, including rage and energy.
tooltip: Evocation restores nearby allies' primary resources.

name: Boon of the Curseweaver
description: All Curses can coexist. Casting one Curse applies the highest rank you know of every Curse.
tooltip: Your Curses coexist and are cast together.

name: Boon of Patient Growth
description: Your healing-over-time effects pause their ticks and duration while their target is at full health, resuming when the target is injured.
tooltip: Healing-over-time pauses on targets at full health.

name: Boon of Cleanse
description: Every 6 seconds, automatically remove one harmful Magic, Disease, or Poison effect from an ally. This has no range or line-of-sight requirement and triggers no global cooldown.
tooltip: Automatically Cleanse one ally every 6 sec.

name: Boon of the Lightning Rod
description: Every active totem draws a Lightning Bolt from you every 10 seconds. Every enemy in the path between you and that totem is struck.
tooltip: Every totem draws a piercing Lightning Bolt every 10 sec.
